Subject: New vendor onboarding request: Nimbus Logistics

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call earlier. We're ready to start Redwood's vendor onboarding so we can receive POs and set up billing. Attached are our current W-9 and a completed security questionnaire draft. To keep things moving, can you confirm:

- Preferred PO instructions and remittance address
- Redwood's vendor intake form / any additional fields you require

I've copied our finance lead if you need direct accounting details.

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: New vendor onboarding request: Nimbus Logistics

Looping procurement/finance — Nimbus wants vendor setup and PO/billing details. Quick proposed checklist (what we need from them / what we will provide):

What we need from Nimbus:
- Completed Redwood vendor intake form (link below)
- W-9 and copy of gov't tax ID (they attached W-9)
- Remittance address and preferred invoice email
- Point of contact for invoice disputes
- Completed security questionnaire or SOC attestation if available

What Redwood will provide:
- PO creation and reference naming convention
- Standard payment terms (Net 30 default) and ACH details
- Vendor record creation ETA: 3 business days after intake form + W-9
- DocuSign for master services or addenda if needed

Can you confirm the payment terms and whether we need EDI setup? If not, I'll send the intake link and a single consolidated checklist to Marta.

S

--
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: New vendor onboarding request: Nimbus Logistics

Thanks — looks good. A couple of notes:

- Request ACH details + remittance and 'bill-to' legal name specifically for accounting. Include bank contact and EIN.
- Ask if they need a specific invoice PO field or cost center code for Redwood POs.
- If vendor invoices > $50k monthly, we flag for SOW/contract review; otherwise the standard MSA addendum covers it.
- No EDI for now unless vendor confirms high invoice volume; we'll treat as manual invoicing.

Once you send the checklist to Marta, CC finance@redwood.ai and billing@redwood.ai so payments route correctly.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@nimbuslogistics.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, finance@redwood.ai, billing@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding request: Nimbus Logistics — Redwood purchase onboarding playbook

Hi Marta — thanks for sending the W-9 and questionnaire. Next steps to get Nimbus fully onboarded and able to receive POs:

1) Please complete the Redwood vendor intake form: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/vendor-intake-form
2) Confirm remittance address and preferred invoice email + ACH details (bank+account name + EIN)
3) Return the completed security questionnaire (you already attached a draft; we'll review)
4) Sign the onboarding acknowledgement (DocuSign): https://redwood.app/contracts/docuSign/12345

What we'll do on our side:
- Create your vendor record within 3 business days after we receive the intake form + W-9
- Issue your first PO and confirm invoice reference format
- Route payments via billing@redwood.ai; standard terms Net 30 unless otherwise agreed

I've attached our vendor onboarding checklist for your convenience. If you can get the intake form + ACH details back by end of next week (6/11), we should be able to start processing POs the week of 6/14.

Questions? Reply to this thread or reach out to Laura directly.

Thanks,

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
